meta.name: security-audit
meta.description: Deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, data protection, dependency vulnerabilities, and secrets scanning. Delegates to the Centinela (QA) agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码中的安全漏洞与配置风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在发布前发现并修复安全漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Scan code for security vulnerabilities and configuration risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and fix security vulnerabilities before release.

howto.what: Claude 会委托 Centinela(QA)agent 做安全审计:检查 OWASP Top 10、密钥扫描、依赖漏洞;有 Solidity 则查智能合约。报告给出 APPROVED 或 CHANGES REQUIRED,只记录不修复。
howto.when: 当用户发出 /security-audit(可带目录)时触发;典型时机为发布前、改动认证/授权/数据处理代码后,或新增依赖/外部集成时。

say.note: 会生成该目录的安全审计报告。

say.text: 按 OWASP Top 10 审计整个项目,重点看硬编码密钥。
say.note: 会扫描密钥并输出报告。

say.text: 新增了第三方依赖,请做一次安全审计。
say.note: 会检查依赖漏洞并给出结论。

howto.what_en: Claude delegates to the Centinela (QA) agent for a security audit: OWASP Top 10 checks, secret scanning, dependency vulnerabilities, and smart contracts if Solidity is present. It reports APPROVED or CHANGES REQUIRED and only documents findings, never fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggers on /security-audit (with optional directory scope). Typical times: before a release, after auth/authz/data-handling changes, or when adding dependencies or external integrations.

say_en.note: Generates an audit report for that directory.

say_en.text: Audit the whole project for OWASP Top 10, focusing on hardcoded secrets.
say_en.note: Scans secrets and outputs a report.

say_en.text: We added a third-party dependency; please run a security audit.
say_en.note: Checks dependency vulnerabilities and gives a verdict.
